explanation: The counterclockwise parametrization is x=7cos(t), y=2sin(t), 0≤t≤2π. Thus 2x/y=7cot(t) and ds=√(49sin²(t)+4cos²(t))dt=√(45sin²(t)+4)dt, giving option d. This is the equivalent parametrized expression; the integral does not converge as an ordinary improper integral because y=0 on the curve.
